'''December 2001 Littlehampton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Littlehampton, West Sussex, England on 16 December 2001. [[William Wood]] won it. It is known from Elliott Weights's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3239">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-07-littlehampton-16-12-01d3239/ littlehampton-16-12-01], DeckTech (Elliott "Dengar 69" Weights, 7 January 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-07-littlehampton-16-12-01d3239/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 December 2001
* '''Site:''' Littlehampton, West Sussex, England
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[William Wood]]
